purpose: Internal construction and local evaluation of a pattern-derived synthetic stateful recovery task family; rollout collection and training remain unapproved

scopes.training: Denied pending a superseding EF-03-accepted receipt. Candidate rows are design inputs, not authorized training data.
scopes.evaluation: Local, offline evaluation only. The canaried terminal-bench package and visible_eval rows are excluded from training, solution exposure, and trajectory distillation.
scopes.derivative: Synthetic variants may be created only if they remain non-reconstructive of the private source task and preserve the split boundary.
scopes.export: No external publication, hosted deployment, dataset upload, or third-party training transfer without a superseding founder-approved receipt.

retention: Synthetic source, manifests, verifier logic, aggregate grades, and redacted traces may remain in Git; raw model traces stay outside Git until separately reviewed.
revocation: Remove affected rows from future dataset builds, stop new rollouts, and supersede this receipt. Quarantine derived checkpoints until deletion or approved retraining is complete.
deletion_propagation: Delete local rollout artifacts and future manifests derived from a revoked row; record checkpoint disposition outside the public repository.
approval_authority: EF-03 Rights OS plus founder approval for external processors or training
source_grant_basis: The user authorized creation of a non-reconstructive synthetic benchmark from the private session pattern; the private session payload itself is excluded.
limitations: The originating Codex task is private evidence intake and is not licensed into this repository.
No private payload, credential, source database, personal record, screenshot, or source-repository code is included.
Terminal-Bench and HUD upstream code, services, names, and marks retain their own licenses and terms.
EF-03 acceptance and a superseding receipt are required before any rollout collection or training.
Do not set HUD_API_KEY, enable HUD telemetry/file tracking, call a remote model API, sync, deploy, upload, or use HUD TrainingClient under this receipt.
